name: hcapp_setEventRsvp
description: Updates a hasher's RSVP state and/or hare designation for an event. Upserts a HasherEventMap row if none exists. Blocks RSVP state changes when the hasher is already checked in (AttendenceState >= 20), but still allows hare-flag-only changes post-attendance. Optionally auto-sets notification preferences when @autoSetNotifications=1. Updates Event.Hares aggregate string when hare state changes. Returns a success envelope (rowset 0), an adHoc result row (rowset 1), and delegates to HC6.hcapp_syncEventAdminData for subsequent sync rowsets.

parameters.name: deviceId
parameters.description: Registered device UUID. Passed to HC6.ValidateAppAuth.

parameters.name: accessToken
parameters.description: Short-lived cryptographic token validated against the device secret.

parameters.name: eventId
parameters.description: Event to RSVP for. Must match the event resolved from @hemId when @hemId is provided.

parameters.name: hasherId
parameters.description: Target hasher. Defaults to the authenticated caller when NULL. Overridden by the UserId resolved from @hemId when @hemId is provided.

parameters.name: isHare
parameters.description: Sentinel: -1 normalised to NULL (keep existing). 1 = set hare, 0 = clear hare. When @rsvpState=1 (not coming), forced to 0 before sentinel normalisation. Table column is SMALLINT — wider INT parameter accepted but stored as SMALLINT.
parameters.typeMismatch: Parameter INT; column HasherEventMap.IsHare is SMALLINT

parameters.name: rsvpState
parameters.description: Sentinel: -1 normalised to NULL (keep existing). Known domain values: 1=not coming, 2=maybe, 3=coming. Table column is SMALLINT — wider INT parameter accepted but stored as SMALLINT.
parameters.typeMismatch: Parameter INT; column HasherEventMap.RsvpState is SMALLINT

parameters.name: hasherEventMapUpdatedAfter
parameters.description: Sync watermark forwarded to HC6.hcapp_syncEventAdminData. Defaults to 'ignore' when NULL.

parameters.name: hasherKennelMapUpdatedAfter
parameters.description: Sync watermark forwarded to HC6.hcapp_syncEventAdminData. Defaults to 'ignore' when NULL.

parameters.name: hemId
parameters.description: Optional direct HEM lookup. When provided, @hasherId is overridden with the UserId from the HEM row. A mismatch between the HEM's EventId and @eventId returns errorCode=1226, errorType=12.

parameters.name: autoSetNotifications
parameters.description: Default 1. When 1: if @rsvpState=1 (not coming), sets EventNotificationPreference and EventEmailAlertPreference to 2; otherwise reads defaults from HasherKennelMap for the resolved kennel.

rowsets.name: SuccessEnvelope
rowsets.description: Write SP success envelope. Always returned as the first rowset. On any error path (auth, validation, unhandled) success=0 and errorCode/errorType are populated; on success success=1 and errorCode/errorType are NULL.

columns.name: errorCode
columns.description: Numeric error code. NULL on success. 1226=mismatched hemId/eventId (errorType 12); 1926=unhandled DB error (errorType 19).

columns.name: errorType
columns.description: Error classification. NULL on success. 11=auth failure (from ValidateAppAuth); 12=validation/mismatch; 19=unhandled CATCH.

rowsets.name: ErrorDetail
rowsets.description: Returned as rowset 1 on any error path (auth failure, hemId/eventId mismatch, unhandled CATCH). Not returned on success.

columns.name: errorId
columns.description: Unique ID of the HC.ErrorLog entry.

rowsets.name: AdHocRsvpResult
rowsets.description: Single row returned on all success paths, including no-change paths. When RSVP could not be changed (user checked in, state unchanged), success=1 but serverMessage contains a human-readable reason. Values are re-read from DB after the write.

columns.name: adHocDataId
columns.description: Always 1. Identifies the adHoc data type to the caller.

columns.name: serverMessage
columns.description: Empty string on a clean write. Populated with a displayable reason when RSVP could not be changed (already checked in) or state was already identical. Uses '~~' as a sentence separator.

columns.name: hasherEventMapId
columns.description: The HEM record ID (newly generated on INSERT, existing ID on UPDATE).

columns.name: rsvpState
columns.description: Current RsvpState after the write, re-read from HC.HasherEventMap.

columns.name: willHareState
columns.description: Current IsHare after the write, re-read from HC.HasherEventMap.

columns.name: hares
columns.description: Updated Event.Hares aggregate string (STRING_AGG of hare display names). NULL when @isHare did not change.

columns.name: eventNotificationPreference
columns.description: Current EventNotificationPreference after the write, re-read from HC.HasherEventMap.

columns.name: emailAlertPreference
columns.description: Current EventEmailAlertPreference after the write, re-read from HC.HasherEventMap.

rowsets.name: SyncEventAdminData
rowsets.description: Rowset(s) 2 and beyond are produced by the delegated call to HC6.hcapp_syncEventAdminData. Refer to that SP's contract for the full rowset definitions. hashersUpdatedAfter, narrowEventsUpdatedAfter, paymentsUpdatedAfter, kennelCreditsUpdatedAfter, and receiptsUpdatedAfter are all passed as 'ignore'.

sideEffects: UPDATE HC.HasherEventMap SET RsvpState, IsHare, EventNotificationPreference, EventEmailAlertPreference — when conditions met and HEM row exists
INSERT HC.HasherEventMap — when no HEM row exists for the eventId/hasherId pair
UPDATE HC.Event SET Hares — when IsHare state changed (STRING_AGG of hare display names where RsvpState=3)
INSERT HC.ErrorLog — on hemId/eventId mismatch and on unhandled CATCH
EXEC HC.nonApi_updateRunCountsByUser — called after transaction commit with @hasherId and event date
EXEC HC6.hcapp_syncEventAdminData — delegated call outside transaction

codeSmells.issue: Parameter type wider than column: @isHare INT vs SMALLINT
codeSmells.detail: @isHare is declared INT but HasherEventMap.IsHare is SMALLINT. SQL Server will accept and silently narrow the value on write. No overflow risk in practice given domain values (0/1/-1), but the mismatch is misleading and could mask future misuse.

codeSmells.issue: Parameter type wider than column: @rsvpState INT vs SMALLINT
codeSmells.detail: @rsvpState is declared INT but HasherEventMap.RsvpState is SMALLINT. Same silent narrowing as @isHare.

codeSmells.issue: Hares aggregate re-read uses UserId, not hemId
codeSmells.detail: After the write, @newHareState is fetched by EventId+UserId (line 251-252), which is correct for the INSERT path where @hemId is just assigned. However, for the UPDATE path entered via @hemId where @hasherId was populated from the HEM row, this is consistent. Low actual risk but the lookup bypasses the hemId fast-path used elsewhere.

EXEC HC.nonApi_updateRunCountsByUser runs after COMMIT at line 283. If it fails, the HEM write is already committed but run counts are stale. This is inherited from HC5 and accepted as a known tradeoff, but it means run counts can diverge from attendance data.

codeSmells.issue: autoSetNotifications check against @rsvpState after sentinel normalisation
codeSmells.detail: At line 172, @autoSetNotifications logic checks IF (@rsvpState = 1). By this point the sentinel -1 has NOT yet been normalised (normalisation happens at lines 122-123, after the notification block). The ordering is correct — sentinel normalisation comes after the notification block — but this is fragile. If the order of these blocks were swapped in a future edit, the condition would break silently.

codeSmells.issue: HcVersion hardcoded as '<unknown>' in ErrorLog inserts
codeSmells.detail: Both INSERT HC.ErrorLog statements (lines 103 and 273) use the literal string '<unknown>' for HcVersion. Other HC6 SPs use a configured version string or constant. Low impact but inconsistent.

The serverMessage string at line 241 uses '~~' to separate two sentences. This is a display protocol the client must parse. It is undocumented here and could be mishandled by clients that do not implement the split. Not a data integrity issue but a coupling smell.

breakingChanges: HC5 bug fixed: the condition allowing hare-flag-only changes while attended used '@rsvpState = -1' after the sentinel had already been normalised to NULL, making the branch always false. HC6 correctly uses '@rsvpState IS NULL'.
TRY/CATCH and transaction added — HC5 had neither; unhandled errors now roll back and return a structured error rowset.
Success envelope rowset (rowset 0: success, errorCode, errorType) added — HC5 had no envelope.
HC5 error path returned a single StandardErrors rowset; HC6 returns two rowsets on error: SuccessEnvelope (rowset 0) then ErrorDetail (rowset 1).
Delegation target updated from HC5.hcapp_syncEventAdminData to HC6.hcapp_syncEventAdminData.
nonApi_updateRunCountsByUser now called after transaction commit rather than inline (HC5 had no transaction).
